title: 第8章 这他妈什么破运气-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    蛇胆！

    许默瞳孔猛地一缩。

    中医里，蛇胆明目，凝神静气。

    在【酿酒师】的天赋下，这东西绝对能酿出特殊的效用！

    买下。

    10个幸存点瞬间扣除。

    还带着温热、散发着浓烈腥苦味的暗绿色蛇胆凭空出现在掌心。

    许默立刻切入制造界面，点开【天赋：酿酒】。

    【放入主材料：新鲜的蛇胆×1】

    【放入辅料：纯净水×2】

    【酿造开始……】

    蓝色的进度条在视网膜上飞速跳动。

    叮——！

    【酿造成功！】

    【获得物品：蛇胆酒×1】

    【物品详情：蛇胆酒】

    【效果：恢复理智10点，体力10点，干渴10点。】

    【附加状态：获得24小时“冷血”效果。期间精神极度集中，疲劳感大幅度降低，理智值下降速度减少80%！】

    就是这个。

    许默没有任何犹豫，仰起脖子一饮而尽。

    瞬间的苦涩和回甘，酒香显得更加浓郁。

    只觉得大脑瞬间一片清明。

    所有的恐惧、焦虑，在这一刻都被屏蔽了。

    他的心跳变得异常平缓，双手不再颤动。

    冷血状态，起效了。

    许默深吸一口冷空气，借着微弱的月光，从背包里抽出之前砍伐的木材。

    精钢手斧在树冠上无声地挥舞。

    削尖，打磨。

    一根根粗糙却致命的木质长矛在他手中快速成型。

    漫长的黑夜在极致的冷静中悄然流逝。

    当第一缕晨光艰难地撕破迷雾，照亮这片死寂的荒原时。

    身下的树干传来一声极其沉闷的断裂声。

    这棵原本就枯死的树，在经历了一夜的摧残后，终于到了强弩之末。

    底下的怪物也察觉到了猎物的穷途末路。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Snake gallbladder!

Xu Mo’s pupils shrank suddenly.

In traditional Chinese medicine, snake gallbladder improves eyesight and calms the mind.

With the talent of the [Wine Maker], this thing can definitely produce special effects!

​Buy it.

10 survival points are deducted instantly.

The dark green snake gall, which was still warm and exuded a strong fishy and bitter smell, appeared out of thin air in the palm of the hand.

Xu Mo immediately entered the manufacturing interface and clicked on [Talent: Brewing].

【Put in the main ingredient: fresh snake gall ×1】

【Add auxiliary materials: purified water × 2】

【Brewing begins...】

The blue progress bar jumps rapidly on the retina.

Ding——!

【Brewing successful!】

【Item obtained: Snake gall wine × 1】

【Item details: Snake gall wine】

【Effect: Restore sanity 10 points, physical strength 10 points, thirst 10 points.】

【Additional status: Obtain 24-hour "cold-blooded" effect.During this period, the spirit is extremely concentrated, the fatigue is greatly reduced, and the rate of decline in sanity is reduced by 80%!】

This is it.

Xu Mo didn’t hesitate, raised his neck and drank it all in one gulp.

The instant bitterness and sweetness make the wine aroma more intense.

I just feel that my brain is suddenly clear.

All fears and anxieties were blocked at this moment.

His heartbeat became extremely slow and his hands stopped shaking.

The cold-blooded state has taken effect.

Xu Mo took a deep breath of cold air, and under the faint moonlight, he took out the wood he had cut down earlier from his backpack.

The steel hand ax was swung silently in the tree crown.

Sharpening, polishing.

Rough but deadly wooden spears quickly took shape in his hands.

The long dark night passed quietly in the ultimate calm.

When the first ray of morning light struggled to break through the fog and illuminated this dead wasteland.

There was an extremely dull snapping sound from the tree trunk beneath him.

This tree, which was already dead, finally reached the end of its life after a night of devastation.

The monster below also sensed that its prey was at its end.
